Hey welcome to Lynsie Lou’s Vlogs! I’m just having fun sharing little clips of my life and I hope you enjoy watching☺️ 

I’m an expecting momma and hairstylist/massage therapist as well, located in IL. So join me while I share my home life and work life🫶🏻  

Instagram - @massagesandmanes
TikTok- @lynsiecook
